red.title: Health Commissioner Declares Code Red Extreme Heat Alert for Wednesday, July 15th and Thursday, July 16th
red.summary: Dr. Michelle Taylor, Baltimore City Commissioner of Health, has declared a Code Red Extreme Heat Alert for Wednesday, July 15, 2026 through Thursday, July 16, 2026.

water.title: Service Alert (11/25/2026) Sisson Street Residential Recycling Center Temporarily Closed
water.summary: The Sisson Street Residential Recycling Center remains temporarily closed as crews complete work related to a recent water main break. The facility is expected to reopen on Friday, November 27.
